lines.en: Decaying body drags on the ground.
Decaying flesh sways in the breeze.
Its leg bones rattle as it runs!
It charges through the ruins, howling!
Decaying flesh moves in the wind.
Corpse stares at you, don't move.

lines.zh: 小腿折了，我拖着它往前爬。
lines.en: My shin breaks; I drag it and keep crawling.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，渗出的血水在腐烂的皮肤上闪烁。
lines.en: It stares at you, with blood seeping from its rotting skin.

lines.zh: 你闻到了它口中的腐肉气息。
lines.en: You smell the stench of rotten meat from its mouth.

lines.zh: 它用断肢敲打着地面，似乎在召唤你。
lines.en: It bangs its missing limbs on the ground, seemingly summoning you.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，仿佛喉咙中有腐肉在蠕动。
lines.en: It hisses, as if the rotting flesh in its throat is moving.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛发出绿光，盯着你，等待机会。
lines.en: Its eyes glow green, staring at you, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在阳光下显得更加苍白，仿佛快要腐烂。
lines.en: Its skin appears even paler under the sunlight, as if it is about to rot.

lines.zh: 你看到了它嘴边的脓包，里面似乎藏有病菌。
lines.en: You see a pus-filled bump at its mouth, as if it holds a pathogen.

lines.zh: 它的声音空洞而嘶哑，仿佛从死神那里借来。
lines.en: Its voice is hollow and hoarse, as if borrowed from death itself.

lines.zh: 它的目光空洞，却充满了对生命的渴望。
lines.en: Its vacant eyes are filled with a desperate desire for life.

lines.zh: 它用断腿尝试敲击地面，希望吸引同伴。
lines.en: It bangs its missing legs on the ground, hoping to attract its peers.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，它转头看着你，愤怒地嘶吼。
lines.en: You collide with it, and it turns to you with an angry growl.

lines.zh: 它的皮肉被撞得裂开，露出里面的肉。
lines.en: Its flesh is torn open, revealing the meat inside.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞得摇晃，像是要散架一样。
lines.en: Its body shakes from the impact, as if it's about to fall apart.

lines.zh: 它踉跄着倒下，流着血的伤口渗出鲜血。
lines.en: It staggers to the ground, blood oozing from its wounds.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它的断腿，它痛苦地嘶叫。
lines.en: You hit its missing leg, and it screams in pain.

lines.zh: 它踉跄地倒退，试图避开你的撞击。
lines.en: It staggers back, trying to avoid your impact.

lines.zh: 它的皮肉在碰撞中破损，流着脓血。
lines.en: Its flesh is torn in the collision, oozing pus and blood.

lines.zh: 它的嘶吼声中夹杂着痛苦和愤怒。
lines.en: Its growl is a mix of pain and anger.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它的肚子，它痛苦地呻吟。
lines.en: You hit its belly, and it groans in pain.

lines.zh: 它倒地挣扎，痛苦地嘶吼着。
lines.en: It struggles on the ground, screaming in pain.

lines.zh: 它看着同伴，眼中充满了爱慕。
lines.en: It looks at its mate, eyes filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它走近同伴，试图触碰它。
lines.en: It approaches its mate, trying to touch it.

lines.zh: 它的嘶吼中透露出对繁殖的渴望。
lines.en: Its growl reveals a desire for reproduction.

lines.zh: 它用肢体语言邀请伴侣，希望得到回应。
lines.en: It uses body language to invite its mate, hoping for a response.

lines.zh: 它的目光紧盯着伴侣，等待着回应。
lines.en: Its eyes are fixed on its mate, waiting for a response.

lines.zh: 它轻轻触碰伴侣的皮肤，表达爱意。
lines.en: It gently touches its mate’s skin, expressing its affection.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，希望引起伴侣注意。
lines.en: It hisses, hoping to catch its mate’s attention.

lines.zh: 它试图靠近伴侣，却被推开。
lines.en: It tries to get close to its mate, but is pushed away.

lines.zh: 它盯着伴侣，眼神中充满渴望。
lines.en: It stares at its mate, eyes filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它用触碰表达亲近，希望得到爱的回应。
lines.en: It uses touch to express closeness, hoping for an affectionate response.

lines.zh: 地上一袋罐头，先捡起来。
lines.en: A bag of cans on the ground — mine first.

lines.zh: 喉咙里挤出声音，我盯上你了。
lines.en: A sound tears from my throat. You're mine.
The rubble you stepped on still rattles.
It is already lunging at you!
It charges with its head down!
The howl sticks in its throat!
Its broken leg drags a long mark!
It has no intention of stopping!

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩膀，牙陷进肉里。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder; my teeth sink into flesh.
It knocks you down and pins you!
Even its broken leg kicks at you!
This ruin will feed us a while.
A shape bursts out from behind the rubble!
It rises out of a pool of blood!
A howl comes from the street corner!

lines.zh: 火烧到烂肉，我闻到自己焦了。
lines.en: Fire catches my rotten flesh; I smell myself burning.
